title: Juniper and the Asset
author: Coral Thornbury
blurb: Mara Marchetti, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
